stories.title: Rubio orders Iran's UN delegation to leave the US immediately after ceasefire talks stall
stories.reason: The unusual diplomatic rebuke had the State Department tell Foreign Minister Araghchi's delegation to leave New York hours after negotiations broke down, deepening the rift just as Tehran was weighing Washington's response to its Hormuz ceasefire proposal.

stories.title: Google launches Project Suncatcher, sending AI chips into orbit to test space-based data centers
stories.reason: A refrigerator-sized satellite carrying four TPUs running Google's Gemma model is testing whether constellations of solar-powered satellites, communicating by laser, could one day offload AI compute from power-hungry terrestrial data centers.

stories.title: Morocco's king appoints Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri as the country's first female prime minister
stories.reason: The former Marrakesh mayor and housing minister, whose centrist party won last week's election without a majority, now must build a coalition government, making her only the third woman to lead a government in the Arab world.

stories.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits its highest level since 2002 as bond market rout deepens
stories.reason: Persistent inflation, heavy government borrowing and Middle East-driven oil prices pushed the benchmark yield to 5.34%, with the 30-year rate also at a 24-year high, squeezing borrowing costs just as stocks hover near records.

stories.title: UN mission says Pakistani airstrikes in Afghanistan killed 10 civilians, most of them children
stories.reason: Islamabad says the overnight strikes on Helmand and Kunar hit militant hideouts tied to the TTP and the Balochistan Liberation Army and killed 22 fighters, but UNAMA's independent count of civilian deaths threatens to further inflame Pakistan-Afghanistan tensions.

stories.title: UCLA's light-powered AI system detects deepfake videos with nearly 98% accuracy
stories.reason: The hybrid optical-digital processor can screen 15 videos simultaneously in a single pass at a fraction of the energy cost of conventional detectors, offering a scalable defense as AI-generated video becomes harder to distinguish from real footage.

stories.title: Blasts heard across Addis Ababa hours after Ethiopia's government banned drone flights
stories.reason: Explosions near the city center and military headquarters, which a rebel alliance claimed as drone strikes, came as fighting between federal and regional forces intensified in the northern Tigray region, raising fears the conflict is spreading to the capital.

stories.title: South Korea's exports hit a record $120.9 billion in September as chip sales nearly triple
stories.reason: Semiconductor shipments topped $60 billion for the first time as AI-driven global demand pushed the monthly export total above $120 billion for the first time ever, lifting the trade surplus to a record $49.85 billion.
